title: Remove Duplicates In Order
description:
Write a function `remove_duplicates(items)` that returns a new list containing only the unique elements of `items`, keeping their original order of appearance.
Do not mutate the original list.
hints: Deduplication requires remembering what you have already observed without disrupting the input order.
Be careful not to call .remove() or .pop() directly on the argument list.
Using set(items) loses the original sequence ordering.
Maintain a tracking set alongside a new output list, appending items only on their first appearance.
